positive_signals: real editorial photography or tactile paper construction
natural lens behavior and practical lighting
small physical imperfections and believable material texture
large low-detail negative space reserved for deterministic headline composition
story objects that directly support the verified video hook
negative_signals: AI-generated logos, mascots, UI, charts, words, letters, or numbers
pseudo-writing, fake handwriting, illegible diagrams, or text-like marks anywhere in the generated plate
random cables, glyphs, buttons, screens, or decorative technology
fake shocked faces, malformed hands, and repeated objects

composition_contract.official_identity: always composited afterward from a transparent official asset
composition_contract.headline: always typeset afterward; 2-5 words; maximum two lines
composition_contract.source_proof: always inserted afterward from an English evidence asset

learning_loop.update_rule: Promote repeated accepted visual traits into positive_signals and repeated rejection reasons into negative_signals; never alter factual or brand constraints.
